refactor(role): replace Owner with Admin role
- Remove Owner enum from Role.java, User.ts, and operatorGuard - Replace owner API endpoints with admin across ledger and supplier modules - Remove Owner workspace sections and update roleWorkspace router - Update @Access annotations to exclude Owner in all Java controllers - Add finance, supplierApproval, and serviceAssignment entries to admin panel - Remove roleOwner locale and update Role.java Javadoc - Initialize extl app with router-view and scanRouting - Clear deprecated DDL from warmup.sql

feat(booking-detail): add textarea and tooltip enhancements to form
- Set type="textarea" with autosize on port, preCarriageBy and marksAndNO inputs - Added el-tooltip on table column headers to show full text on overflow - Replaced containerQuantity el-input with el-input-number for numeric validation - Added computed property for containerQuantity with string-to-number conversion - Added .table-header-text CSS class with single-line ellipsis overflow - Reformatted ReservationFlowReadController.java from compressed to standard style

feat(supplier): add Jacksonized support and Serializable interface
- Added @Jacksonized annotation for Jackson-compatible builder deserialization - Added @AllArgsConstructor to support Jacksonized with SuperBuilder - Explicitly implemented Serializable interface on SupplierProfile - Added java.io.Serializable import - Reformatted serialVersionUID declaration for readability

refactor(booking): remove booking creation wizard from merchandiser modules
- Deleted createWizard.vue and formStep.vue components in both merchandiser and merchandiserManager bookingManagement modules - Removed SlotPreset type and WizardControl composable from booking.ts - Cleaned up unused imports (reactive, Slot type) in booking.ts - Eliminated the step-based dialog flow for slot selection and booking form submission

style(ledger): reformat controller and service for readability
- Expanded single-line class and method declarations to multi-line - Added proper indentation with 4-space standard - Separated annotations onto individual lines - Added blank lines between methods for visual grouping - Formatted import statements with proper spacing

fix(booking-management): fix card row compression
- Added grid-auto-rows: max-content to prevent row height compression - Added align-content: start and overflow-y: auto for card grid scrolling - Wrapped status/carrier/danger tags in flex container with flex-wrap - Set min-width basis on route-info to allow tag wrapping on narrow cards - Made cargo grid columns responsive using auto-fit with minmax(150px, 1fr) - Reduced card grid gap to 12px in mobile media query - Reformatted ReservationFlowService method bodies for readability - Reformatted ReservationFlowStage enum value declarations

style(ledger): reformat Bill class annotations and add serialVersionUID
- Moved annotations to separate lines for improved readability - Added spaces around equals signs in annotation attributes - Added space after commas in generic type parameters - Added @Serial annotation with serialVersionUID field for Bill class

fix(inquiry): handle BigDecimal scale differences in equality checks
- Override equals and hashCode in InquiryOfferDetail to use compareTo instead of equals for BigDecimal amount fields, treating values like 2000 and 2000.0 as equal - Apply the same scale-insensitive comparison to inner LocalFee class for unitPrice, quantity, and amount fields - Add unit tests verifying offer detail equality ignores amount scale - Reformat financeLedgerWorkspace.vue and ReservationFlowDialog.vue for improved readability without functional changes

style(code): apply consistent formatting across source files
- Broke long single-line statements into multiple lines in adminAPI.ts - Reformatted setEnabled function in accountList.vue for readability - Split chained FormData operations into separate statements in attachmentAPI.ts - Added semicolons to auto-imports.d.ts declarations in intl and extl apps - Removed unnecessary empty lines in extl App.vue - Applied multi-line formatting to type re-export blocks in auto-imports.d.ts

feat(attachment): return uploaded document ID from upload endpoints
- Changed upload method return type from void to BigInteger in AttachmentMerchandiserApplication and AttachmentMerchandiserManagerApplication - Updated controller response type from Result<Void> to Result<String> to expose the created document ID to clients - Both Merchandiser and MerchandiserManager upload endpoints now return the uploaded document identifier as a string

feat(ledger): add aging and profit analytics
- Add AgingRules service with bucket-based overdue calculation - Add enriched page endpoint with query and status filters - Add overview, statement, and profit report API endpoints - Extend CurrencySummary with invoicedAmount and settlementRate - Add paidTotal helper to LedgerRules excluding revoked payments - Add accountPrice and costCurrency to InquiryConversionSnapshot - Add Element Plus locale binding in App.vue for zh/en switch - Remove legacy financeLedgerWorkspace and Treasurer route - Update workspace module to reference new finance component path

feat(reservation): add operator override for bill reconciliation
- Added reconciliation stage UI with bill status table in ReservationFlowDialog - Implemented overrideClientBillReconciliation in LedgerService for operator action - Added forceBillingReconciliation flag handling in ReservationFlowService advance logic - Integrated reconciliation override into MerchandiserManager and Merchandiser controllers - Added ElRadioButton and ElRadioGroup type declarations for Vue components

chore(sql): remove mainline migration script
- Deleted document/sql/MAINLINE_MIGRATION.sql - Removed ALTER TABLE statements for inquiry, reservation, client_profile, user - Removed CREATE TABLE definitions for currency, fee_item, port, supplier, reservation_flow, bills, payments, invoices, invoice_request - Removed role migration UPDATE and currency seed INSERT statements

chore(deps): update dependencies across vue packages
- Updated astro from ^7.3.5 to ^7.3.8 in client app - Updated element-plus from ^2.14.6 to ^2.14.7 in extl and intl - Updated vue-i18n from ^11.4.12 to ^11.4.14 in extl and intl - Updated @rsbuild/core from ^2.2.9 to ^2.2.12 in extl and intl - Updated @rsbuild/plugin-type-check from ^1.6.0 to ^1.6.1 - Updated @rsdoctor/rspack-plugin from ^1.6.4 to ^1.6.5 - Updated @types/node from ^26.6.3 to ^26.6.5 - Updated @vue/language-server from ^3.3.11 to ^3.3.13 - Updated @vue/typescript-plugin from ^3.3.11 to ^3.3.13 - Updated prettier from ^3.9.9 to ^3.9.10 - Updated pnpm lock file accordingly

chore(auto-imports): update generated type declaration formatting
- Added semicolons to all const declarations in extl and intl apps - Reformatted export type statements into multi-line format with trailing commas - Changes reflect updated auto-imports.d.ts generation output format

refactor(build): use postbuild hook to run collect-dist script
- Moved collect-dist.ts execution from build commands to postbuild lifecycle hook - Removed inline && chaining from build, build:production, and build:development scripts - Added extl app configuration to dist collection targets in collect-dist.ts

perf(client): self-host Google Fonts removing external CDN
- Replaced Google Fonts CDN links with local stylesheet in Layout.astro - Added download-google-fonts.mjs script for self-hosting font assets - Added nginx caching rules for woff2 font files (365d, immutable) - Added nginx-extl.conf with location blocks for /extl/ routing - Included nginx-extl.conf in main nginx.conf - Renamed package from "former-force" to "client" - Integrated collect-dist.ts into build and build:production scripts

style(intl): remove trailing semicolons from auto-imports.d.ts
- Removed semicolons at the end of each type declaration statement - Applied consistent formatting to the auto-generated imports file - Updated auto-imports configuration to exclude semicolons in output

chore(database): add hozai schema dump with seed data
- Added full MySQL database dump for hozai freight forwarding system - Includes table definitions: attachment, audit, bills, client_profile, currency, document - Contains seed/test data for audit logs, bills, and client profiles - Covers the complete booking lifecycle workflow states - Dated 2026-10-14 sourced from dev environment (MySQL 8.4.11)

feat(mysql): expose MySQL port to host in dev compose
- Replaced expose directive with ports mapping for MySQL service - Bound port 3306 to 0.0.0.0 to allow host machine access

feat(reservation): show settled status in flow timeline
- Add settled derived field to ReservationFlow entity and API type - Compute settled status from reservation COMPLETED state in service - Refactor get method into private overload that also sets settled flag - Update timeline UI to display settled state on final stage - Add unit tests for settled status derivation logic - Regenerate auto-imports and components type files (formatting)

refactor(reservation-flow): replace hardcoded strings with i18n enums
- Added ReservationFlowOption enum class with stable codes and message keys - Created frontend flowOptions module mapping codes to i18n message keys - Replaced hardcoded Chinese option strings with enum-based validation in backend - Updated frontend selects to render localized labels via i18n translation - Added locale entries across client, merchandiser, and manager modules - Added backend i18n message properties for all flow option labels - Registered i18n module loader in client router beforeEnter guard

feat(i18n): add i18n for finance bills and booking portal
- Replace hardcoded Chinese strings with t() translation calls in bills.vue - Replace hardcoded Chinese strings with t() translation calls in bookingPortal.vue - Import $translate and I18NModuleLoader utilities - Add paymentMethodText and kindText helpers for dynamic label translation - Load finance locale module idempotently on component mount - Update CSV export headers and download filename to use translations - Translate all dialog titles, form labels, placeholders, and validation messages - Translate ElMessageBox prompts, alerts, and confirmation dialogs - Translate empty state descriptions and error/warning notifications

style(auto-imports): add semicolons and reformat type exports in generated files
- Added trailing semicolons to all const declarations in auto-imports.d.ts - Broke single-line type re-export statements into multi-line format with indentation - Applied consistent formatting to extl and intl app auto-imports declarations - No functional changes, only auto-generated file style updates

- Switched dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org to mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn in apk repositories
